question: Does a parameter-free one-to-one global assignment repair sibling-door collisions for the frozen center-scale score on three newly selected stable 3RScan targets?

predecessor_pairwise.observed_failure: Independent center-scale retrieval confused two sibling doors from the same scan family and achieved 4/6 Top-1; a parameter-free one-to-one assignment was then chosen as the sole structural successor before selecting this confirmation cohort.

frozen_cohort.selection_order: Use candidate_protocol rows in descending area_proxy order. Exclude every exact consumed target triple; require a unique physical (reference_scan_id, target_instance_id); permit at most two targets per reference_scan_id; select the first three rows whose reference and rescan pass frame_rules. Open pose, depth and geometry only; RGB remains unopened until replay.
frozen_cohort.proposal_rule: Use the evaluator-authoritative tight target bounding box, crop raw RGB and square-pad with black. The frame must retain at least 32 pixels of source-image margin.
frozen_cohort.retrieval_rule: Three reference target proposals and three rescan target proposals form a closed roster with exactly one counterpart per target. Independent scores remain diagnostic; the successor returns the maximum-total-score one-to-one assignment.
forbidden: changing the roster size or target list after replay
using target identity inside the assignment solver

frozen_model.pair_score: The unchanged predecessor center-scale score: 0.25 * global/global cosine + 0.75 * maximum cosine where at least one side is a centered 0.5 or 0.25 crop.
frozen_model.assignment: Run scipy.optimize.linear_sum_assignment on the negative 3x3 pair-score matrix. No learned or selected parameter is introduced.
frozen_model.baseline_diagnostic: Apply the same assignment to the global/global cosine matrix only for comparison.

decision_gate.assignment_margin: The selected assignment total must be strictly greater than the next-best complete assignment total.
decision_gate.single_replay: One replay on the frozen target-triple-disjoint cohort; do not tune on its RGB or scores.

claim_boundary: A pass is a small target-triple-disjoint real-image Development confirmation for closed-roster one-to-one matching of three truth-proposed stable indoor 3RScan doors or doorframes. It requires an externally justified complete one-to-one reference/query roster; scan families and the single 3RScan provider may overlap prior Development; proposals use privileged geometry; and target RGB becomes consumed. It is not open-set retrieval, door detection, a portal aperture, named entrance, venue ownership, public access, traversability, approach waypoint, arrival, HANDOFF_READY, provider-independent confirmation, user benefit or mobility-safety evidence.
